The fix is complete and minimal.

**Root cause:** `OrderedMultiDict` inherits from `dict`, so `copy.copy`/`copy.deepcopy` used the default `dict.__reduce_ex__(4)`, which returns a 5-tuple whose 5th element is a `list_iterator` of pairs. `copy._reconstruct` then replays those pairs via `y[key] = value`, which deduplicates repeated keys and keeps only the last value.

**Fix:** Added `__reduce__` returning the 3-tuple `(type(self), (), self.__getstate__())`.
